# Dvergr heal

Effects: Heals 400 health over 4 seconds.

# Introduction

Dvergr heal is a Status effect that heals 400 health over 4 seconds.
During battle, Support Dvergr mages can cast a healing spell that applies Dvergr heal to all Dvergr and players in a 4.32-meter radius around them.

Categorias: Effects
